ground_grid.units: dm, ENU z relative to the origin ground, row-major, row 0 = south (origin_n)

conventions: local NED metres from (lat0, lon0) on the ellipsoid tangent plane at P0 = (lat0, lon0, ground_h_ellipsoid); ENU z = -D + ground0_enu_z; D = -(height above the ORIGIN ground) (tools/export_trajectories.py)
